text: {"final": {"summary": "Added needs_review(household, score=None, today=None) to eligibility/rules.py. It mirrors is_eligible: returns False unless household.status == 'active', computes the vulnerability score via vulnerability_score(household, today) when score is None, and uses threshold_for(household) so the pregnancy branch is handled. It returns True exactly when the household does not qualify (score < threshold) but is within 5 points of qualifying (score >= threshold - 5), flagging non-pregnant households scoring 55-59 and pregnant households scoring 40-44, and never flags households that already qualify. Also added a NEAR_MISS_BAND = 5 constant; all existing code is unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
